welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.step1Body1: A pocket is wherever you mentally keep a chunk of money — Revolut, Interactive Brokers, your apartment, cash in your drawer. Make one per service or per thing; the structure should match how you already think about your money.
welcome.step1Body2: Don't worry about getting it right the first time. You can split, rename, or merge pockets later.
welcome.step2Body1: Fill each pocket with what's inside: stocks, cash, crypto, real estate, cars, whatever counts. Exchange rates and market prices update automatically — everything else you write down once.
welcome.step2Body2: If an asset doesn't have a public price (an apartment, a collection, a car), you set the number. The app trusts you to know your own stuff.
welcome.step3Body1: A snapshot is a monthly photograph of your entire net worth. One click captures the whole picture, and the totals stay fixed even as prices move later.
welcome.step3Body2: You'll end up with one snapshot per month. That's the building block of your timeline.
welcome.step4Body1: We'll email you a gentle reminder when it's time. Five minutes in the app, update the numbers that changed, click snapshot. Then close the tab and live your life.
welcome.step4Body2: That's the whole ritual. Not daily. Not weekly. One day a month.
welcome.step5Title: See the curve, not the ticker
welcome.step5Body1: The Dashboard shows your net worth over months and years — the one chart that actually matters. Not yesterday's 0.3% dip. Not minute-by-minute market noise.
welcome.step5Body2: The slow, honest line that tells you where your capital is really going.
welcome.step6Body1: Twelve snapshots a year, and then another twelve, and another. A decade of snapshots is a decade of your financial story in one honest line.
welcome.step6Body2: No bank, no broker, no spreadsheet can show you that — they don't live long enough. One Day Investor does.
